title: Havenline wildlife roster and meat-cut provenance
purpose: Provenance for the agreed ten animal-meat ART PROPOSALS; not a species-drop registry.

sources.title: Havenline: Frostbound World Atlas
sources.evidence: WILDLIFE (PASSIVE & HOSTILE) panel names DEER, RABBIT, SQUIRREL, FOX, BOAR, WOLF, BEAR, LYNX, MOOSE, WOLVERINE. Separate stronger-hostile panel and resource-type row do not define exact species drops.

Lines8 and15-16 have only wood, stone, metal, fuel in KINDS/inventory/stored. Enemy action subtracts wolf health at288-291. Enemy spawn IDs are wolf+serial at381; dead enemies are skipped385-386 and wave-clear removes enemies407-412. No meat/hide/fur/bone/fat drop is created by those inspected runtime paths.
Animal companions are dogs, lions, tigers, bears, wolves, owls and foxes. They are separate companion archetypes using user-supplied references; this is not a food-source list.

Explicit companion actor keys guardian_dog, gray_wolf, fox, owl, male_lion, white_tiger, brown_bear define follow/guard/scout/attack and related capabilities; hunt capability describes an actor action, not that actor being edible or a drop source.

T21 is dependency-independent governance/interface preparation only, with future hunting/combat/loot-conservation proof and forbidden dependency-locked runtime implementation. It does not supply a finished species-drop registry.

boundaries: The atlas confirms a depicted wildlife roster, not that every species is edible, huntable, or an implemented drop.
All ten cut silhouettes are art proposals. Predator-family cuts (wild bear, wild wolf, wild fox, lynx, wolverine) are explicitly optional and food eligibility is unfrozen.
Wild animal families are separate from named companion archetypes. None of the new sheets depicts companion characters, clothing, equipment or bodies; no companions have been reclassified as food.
Strong hostile variants may reuse base-family art for visual planning; neither eligibility nor yields are asserted. No extra stronger-variant meat sheets are part of this bounded expansion.
Generic MEAT, HIDE and FUR resource nouns do not establish species-specific quantities or harvest recipes.
No food safety, biological cut accuracy, final gameplay balance, recipe implementation or native mesh approval is implied.
